title: OFM map.json (Mapbox-GL style + ofm extensions)
description: Mapbox-GL Style Spec v8 with OFM-specific extensions under metadata.ofm. The full Mapbox spec is not validated here — only the top-level shape and the OFM extensions.

version.description: Mapbox-GL Style Spec version. Must be 8.

ofm.description: OFM-specific metadata. Consumed by the world picker and renderer.

parentMap.description: Slug of the parent world (e.g. realmspace for toril). null = top-level.

parentLocation.description: Coordinates of this world within its parent (e.g. star position in the galaxy).

type.description: World-shape hint. Mostly used by space worlds: 'galaxy' for system-of-stars, 'starbase' for a single station with decks, 'map' for a regular surface map.

togglable.description: Layer-group toggles surfaced as checkboxes in the viewer/editor. Each entry hides/shows a named set of map layers.

layers.description: IDs of style layers that participate in this toggle.

height.description: 3D extrusion height (used by the legacy globe view).

legend.description: Color legend rendered next to the toggle.

sources.description: (Optional) source ids tied to this toggle group.

timed.description: Sources whose features are time-bounded — viewer/editor filter by `field_from <= atDate <= field_to`.

field_from.description: Property name holding the start date.

field_to.description: Property name holding the end date.

timeline.description: Two ISO-date strings [min, max] defining the world's playable time range. Drives the time-slider in the editor.

speeds.description: Speed presets for movement simulation (e.g. warp factors). Editor doesn't act on these yet.

distance_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied when converting on-screen distance to `distance_unit`.

distance_unit.description: Unit string used by the distance HUD (e.g. 'ly', 'km', 'au').

relatedLayers.description: Layer ids that may share `relatedField` with a clicked feature.

relatedField.description: Property name used to match clicked feature → related features.

clickLayers.description: Layer ids whose features open the related-layer side panel on click.

time.description: Default in-world date the map opens at (ISO string or year number).

sources.description: Mapbox sources. Keys are source ids; values are source defs with type=vector|raster|geojson|image|video|raster-dem.

layers.description: Render layers. Each layer references a source (except type=background).
